prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire
plan.description: Learn how to change a flat tire safely in a few simple steps. Park safe, loosen the nuts, lift the car, and swap the wheel.

beats.narration: Flat tire on the road? Don't panic. Park on flat, solid ground, turn on your hazard lights, and pull the parking brake.
Loosen the lug nuts slightly before lifting. Then jack up the car, remove the nuts, and pull the flat wheel off.
Mount the spare, tighten the nuts by hand, lower the car, then tighten them fully in a star pattern. Done!

props.text: Tighten the nuts in a star pattern.
